notes: Batch of 15 IRS groups. Verdicts: 7 publish (Questers chapters 1507-ellarslie and abigail-flanner-1524 as unknown, achieveability-community-development-corporation as probably_active, aga-philadelphia-chapter as active, al-dia-foundation as dormant, and action-alliance and actions-for-animals as unknown with no source, so they will be held back); 1 out_of_area (allentown, a judgment from the name, needs a human check); 3 hide private (alpha-chi sorority chapter, two AFGE locals); 2 not_a_group (ambo-inc, anarcho-syndicalist-review); 2 blocked with no record (AAHGS and ASMP, both 403). Searches: the two-search cap was used on Action Alliance and Actions for Animals, which had no usable website; neither search found the group's own page. Questers join page guessed URL returned 404. Batch website for achieveability (MISSIONFIRSTHOUSING.ORG) belongs to Mission First Housing Group, so the group's own site was found separately. Fetches used 15 of the 60 allowed. No rate limiting was seen on other domains. Budget was not exhausted by fetches; it was exhausted by searches.
